content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?JKD Talk · JoinGrant Cooper · May 3, 2024 · Shared with Public groupThere was a lot of controversy about what Chuck Norris said regarding high kicks and Bruce but it's often taken wrong and out of context by many people. In his interview he claims he taught Bruce Lee the kicks he uses and advocated to Bruce the merits of kicking high at times as Bruce was only advocating kicking low as part of self defence. At no point does he say he taught him to kick high but instead says he taught him the kicks he uses. This version of events is backed up by Leo Fong in his interview where he talks about the kicks Chuck Norris taught him.All reactions:679103 comments33 sharesLikeCommentShareMost relevant Tim BechererThere’s quite a difference between “I taught him how to do high kicks” and “I taught him how to do the high kicks I use.” More of this weird shit people get hung up on that in reality makes no difference to their own individual practice.1y14View all 11 repliesJohn P MirrioneI was close with Leo Fong.
